=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, SOLDIERS,
ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME/VILLAGE,
and battle final-frame references.

Keep the same character identities, faces, costumes, weapons,
and environment.

Riven uses the exact same sword shown in her reference.

Ally Soldier uses the same appearance, costume, and weapon
shown in his character reference.

The battle final-frame reference establishes the situation:
Riven and Ally are already fighting together against the surrounding SOLDIERS
on the mountain road.

Do not recreate the exact composition of that image.

Keep the entire scene on the same mountain road.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded realistic action.

Natural movement.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

Simple cinematic camera movement.

Keep the scene visually clear.

Avoid rapid cutting.

All SOLDIERS belong to the same army.

They attack only Riven and Ally.

SOLDIERS never attack each other.

No graphic gore.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Begin close to Riven and Ally already fighting together.

Several SOLDIERS surround them.

Keep the combat brief and simple.

Riven is exhausted.

Ally stays close to her.


During the fight, reveal one SOLDIER farther away holding a bow.

Riven is visible beyond him.

The archer aims directly at Riven.

He fires one arrow.


Follow the arrow as it flies toward Riven.

Riven is still fighting and does not see it.


While the arrow is already flying,
reveal Ally nearby.

Ally suddenly sees the incoming arrow.

He realizes it is heading toward Riven.

He shouts:

"RIVEN!"


Riven begins to turn.

The arrow is already almost reaching her.


Ally immediately throws himself toward Riven.

He uses his own body to shield her.

The arrow hits Ally instead.


Riven catches Ally as he collapses.

Stay close to Riven and Ally.

Riven lowers him into her arms.

She looks at him in shock.


Riven quietly asks:

"Why?"


Ally looks at her and answers weakly:

"You would've done the same."


Ally dies in Riven's arms.

Riven remains still, holding him.


After a quiet moment,
Riven notices something far away.

She slowly looks toward the distant valley.


Far in the direction of her home village,
large columns of dark smoke rise into the sunset sky.

A distant orange fire glow is visible beneath the smoke.

Keep the village far away.

Do not show the destruction up close.


Riven stares at the distant smoke.

She realizes her home is burning.


Then she slowly looks back down at Ally.

She is still devastated by his death.

Riven carefully lowers Ally onto the ground.

She remains kneeling beside him.

End here.

CUT.
